comparison.objective: Candidate installs and fastens rack hardware; record fills a moka-pot base to a safe level and screws on its top.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate combines long-part latching with screwdriver alignment; record combines liquid pouring, coaxial threaded assembly, and hand-derived snug rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks prongs, rack unit, specified screw holes, retention, and no dropped hardware; record checks 122.5–155.8 mL fill, snug 450–720° rotation, thread alignment, and spill/overfill failures.
comparison.reason: Generic screw fastening is insufficient for overlap; the moka task's defining tests are measured fill and hand-threaded closure. Candidate screw torque/depth, cross-thread, and deformation criteria are absent.
